author: RamSet
releaseNotes: Warns you about sun exposure when an exterior door is opened and stays open. Looks up the current UV index and sends a message for that UV band (Low, Moderate, High, Very High, Extreme), optionally strobing a siren on the worst bands and switching it off again after a couple of minutes. Adds a cooldown, so once you have been warned the app stays quiet for a set number of minutes (five by default) however many times the door is opened. Every message is editable, with defaults, and can include the outdoor air quality reading. Leave a band's message blank to stay quiet at that level. The app page now opens with a live panel: the current UV index and band, the outdoor air quality, which bands are set to notify, whether opening a door right now would tell you anything, when the last alert went out, and every door listed as open or closed.
tags: UV, Sun, Air Quality, Contact Sensor, Notification, Safety
